verdict.rationale: Fellow documents natural-language Q&A over meeting data through its MCP Server, with example questions like "What did we decide in last month's standup?" asked from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, scoped to data the user can already access. Its pricing page also lists an "Ask Fellow" feature, and transcripts are searchable. missing for 10: no evidence that answers cite their source meetings or transcript passages, no documentation of the native Ask Fellow experience beyond its name, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
